headline: InMed Pharmaceuticals Completes Merger with Mentari Therapeutics
summary: InMed Pharmaceuticals has completed its merger with Mentari Therapeutics and changed its name to Mentari Therapeutics, Inc. Shares are expected to trade on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol MTRI starting November 9, 2026.
why: Corporate mergers reshape company capital structures and alter ticker symbols on major exchanges, impacting shareholder positions and valuation metrics.

impacts.name: Mentari Therapeutics
impacts.why: Mentari Therapeutics is the surviving entity resulting from the completed merger.
